title: slaitem
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): businesshoursid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, msdyn_customtimecalculationworkflowid, msdyn_SLAKPIID, slaid, transactioncurrencyid, workflowid.

actionflowuniquename.description: Display name: Action Flow Unique Name

allowpauseresume.description: Select whether this SLA will allow pausing and resuming during the time calculation.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the SLA Item

exchangerate.description: Exchange rate between the currency associated with the SLA Item record and the base currency.

failureafter.description: Select how soon the success criteria must be met until the SLA item is considered failed and failure actions are initiated.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

msdyn_customtimecalculation.description: Display name: Custom Time Calculation Flag

name.description: Type a descriptive name of the service level agreement (SLA) item.

relatedfield.description: Select the service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI) that this SLA Item is created for.

sequencenumber.description: Select the time zone, or UTC offset, for this address so that other people can reference it when they contact someone at this address.

slaitemid.description: Unique identifier of the SLA Item.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the SLA Item.

warnafter.description: Select how soon the success criteria must be met before warning actions are initiated.

_businesshoursid_value.description: Choose the business hours for calculating SLA item timelines.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_msdyn_customtimecalculationworkflowid_v.description: Unique identifier for Custom Time Calculation Workflow associated with SLA Item.

_msdyn_slakpiid_value.description: Unique identifier for SLAKPI associated with SLA Item.

_slaid_value.description: Unique identifier for SLA associated with SLA Item.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Unique identifier of the currency associated with the SLA Item record.

_workflowid_value.description: Workflow associated with the SLA Item.
